rejected_rule.statement: A partition decree extinguishes all easements not specifically provided for in the decree, whether such easements be claimed as between co-owners or by the owners of neighboring lands over the land partitioned. The court has power to provide for reasonable servitudes between co-owners in a partition action.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: 'In any view of the case, therefore, plaintiff is entitled to the declaration which he seeks.' and 'It appears clear that a Judge in our own Courts dealing with a partition action may provide for all reasonable servitudes as between the co-owners.'
